item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I've added the entries from our Canon Renaissance team to the hub, per the rules. I had a few Nobody articles before we started this series, but I've come to appreciate and enjoy Nobody as a character and concept in a new way. It was a joy to brainstorm and write, and if even one person leaves wanting to contribute more to this rad canon, I think I'll be happy.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Well… not quite. The Nobody in "Life and Death of Iteration Prime" is the same person throughout. His "purpose" is to discover who he is/was before becoming Nobody. However, each of the Tales also involves at least one individual who could become Nobody at some point in the future.

There's also an subtle theme/Easter egg of sorts running throughout all the non-Interlude Tales. Can you guess what it is?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Oh wow. I did not realize that each story of Nobody in this was a different iteration. I really really like that idea as a whole, and wish I had recognized it, it would have made certain things make a bit more sense.
